pair.gone: This device is no longer available
pair.no_profile: No measured profile exists for this device
pair.unsupported: This profile uses a calculation strategy this version does not support
pair.note: The device you create takes over the controls of the source (on/off, dimming, colour) and adds the estimated consumption. You can then hide the original and keep only this one. While both are visible in Energy, remember to exclude the source so it is not counted twice.
pair.no_profile_line: No profile — enter the power in the settings
pair.warn_manual: No usable profile: to be entered by hand in the settings
pair.warn_always_on: No switch: will be counted as always on
pair.warn_sub_profiles: This profile has variants: the measurement may differ
pair.already_counted: Homey already assigns it __watts__ W: remember to exclude it from Energy after creating, otherwise both values add up.
pair.warn_self_usage: This profile only measures the device itself, not the load it drives

device.no_profile: No profile stored for this device
device.source_gone: The source device is no longer available
device.exclude_manually: Double counting: open the source device in Homey and turn on Settings → Energy → Exclude from Energy. Homey does not let an app do this for you.
device.hidden_but_partial: The source device is hidden but this one does not carry __count__ of its functions. Unhide it: excluding it from Energy is enough to avoid double counting.

widget.add_device: Add this device in Power Estimator
widget.double_counted: Source not excluded from Energy: it is counted twice there.

settings.usages_note: The flow diagram sorts every device by usage. The automatic sorting relies on the Homey device class, which knows nothing about a UPS or an in-wall module: those end up in “Sockets & other”, which becomes the largest slice while telling you nothing. Correct them here.
settings.powered_note: Powered by is for devices that are not really consumers themselves: a UPS, a metered power strip, an in-wall module. What they report is the load of whatever sits behind them. Declare the link and their consumption stops being counted twice.
